risk_summary: The excerpt discloses significant reporting-control and estimate-related risk, including prior and 2014 restatements affecting tax assets, inventory, and expenses. Operating performance also weakened, with declining revenue and gross margin, customer/program losses, government-funding delays, inventory obsolescence, and an FDA-related program hold. Quantification is generally strong, although repeated causal qualifiers and reliance on adjusted metrics somewhat soften the risk presentation.
